firm_note.text: Sierra Legacy Group is a boutique wealth planning firm serving affluent families and family-owned/controlled companies nationwide, focused on legacy, succession, and large life-insurance planning. The firm operates under the M Financial Group network (as Cypress Strategies / M Holdings Securities, Inc., a FINRA/SIPC-member broker-dealer and RIA), giving it access to specialized underwriting and estate-planning resources typically reserved for larger institutional platforms. Its approach centers on thorough discovery, collaborative and flexible solutions, and sustained implementation support, with a stated emphasis on educating clients and dispelling life insurance industry myths. No independent press coverage, industry rankings, or 'best places to work' recognition for the firm itself was found in web search.
firm_note.source: Firm website (sierralegacygroup.com, confirmed as the firm's live site) plus its M Financial member-firm page and cypressnv.com (both represent the same entity); web search for independent firm awards/press came up empty.

Geoffrey Allen Grenert.bio_note: Geoff Grenert founded and leads Sierra Legacy Group (Managing Member/CCO) and has run the firm since 2014, with 28+ years in financial services dating to 1997. Before finance, he was a competitive athlete: pitched at Coronado High School in Scottsdale, AZ, drafted by the Houston Astros in 1989 (27th round) and again in 1990 out of Mesa Community College, then played college ball at the University of Nevada, Reno, where he was drafted by the Chicago White Sox (1992) and California Angels (1993) before a stint in independent/minor league baseball. That athlete-to-advisor path led to a notable niche: he was profiled in WealthManagement.com's feature on former MLB players turned financial advisors, and he currently serves as a Trustee of the MLB Players Trust, giving him a genuine, differentiated network among current and former professional athletes. He is a CFP and holds a California insurance license; industry bios describe him as a 'nationally-recognized expert' in designing and acquiring large life insurance policies, styling himself an 'Architect of Generational Wealth Planning.' He operates through M Holdings Securities, Inc. / Cypress Strategies, an M Financial Group member firm, and lives in the Reno/Tahoe area with his wife Jennifer (also affiliated with the firm) and their four children, active as a Little League coach and golfer.
Geoffrey Allen Grenert.bio_source: ZoomInfo: no record found for Geoffrey Grenert at Sierra Legacy Group specifically (only namesake collisions at unrelated companies, not used). Firm website: sierralegacygroup.com/geoff-grenert confirms title, redirects interchangeably with cypressnv.com/geoff-grenert (same firm, confirmed via 301 redirect, not a rebrand). Web search (primary source): cypressnv.com bio page provided career-length and specialization detail; WealthManagement.com's 'Eleven MLB Players Turned Financial Advisors' article and MLB Players Trust's trustee-appointment announcement corroborated baseball background and board appointment; Baseball-Reference.com and MLB draft records corroborated draft history, teams, and college. No disciplinary/regulatory items reviewed or included.

firm_note.text: Independent, fee-only RIA in Scottsdale founded June 2023 by Trent White after a career managing ultra-high-net-worth relationships at Vanguard. Positions itself as a comprehensive wealth planning firm for retirees, with a low-cost, tax-focused, conflict-free model (no product sales or referral fee revenue) covering investments, taxes, insurance, estate planning, and life planning. Member of NAPFA (fee-only fiduciary standard) and listed in the Paladin Registry. No third-party press, awards, or rankings found for the firm itself beyond standard industry directory listings.
firm_note.source: Firm website (luminvest.com/about, /); web search for firm press/awards across Forbes, business journals, NAPFA, Paladin Registry — no independent recognition found beyond directory/membership listings.

Trent Robert White.bio_note: Founded Luminvest in June 2023 after more than a decade advising high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth families. Immediately prior, he spent about 3.5 years (Dec 2019-June 2023) as a Senior Wealth Advisor for Ultra High Net Worth clients at Vanguard's Personal Advisor Services, where he managed a book exceeding $1 billion in assets across roughly 150 UHNW households — a notably large individual book even by UHNW-advisor standards. He holds a JD from BYU's J. Reuben Clark Law School and an Executive LLM in Taxation with an Estate Planning Certificate from Georgetown University Law Center, on top of a BS in Financial Economics from BYU and his CFP designation. Earlier career included work as a tax preparer and life insurance agent. He's a NAPFA member and has said he left the wirehouse/broker-dealer model specifically to remove conflicts with his fiduciary duty to clients — consistent with Luminvest's conflict-free positioning. No press coverage, speaking engagements, or industry awards found for him individually.
Trent Robert White.bio_source: Firm website (luminvest.com/about): full narrative bio including Vanguard UHNW book size, education, and career history. Web search: corroborated Vanguard tenure dates and role via NAPFA and other advisor-directory sources; searched for press/interviews/podcasts/speaking — none found. ZoomInfo: no contact record found for this person at this firm.

firm_note.text: Intrinsic Value Partners was founded in 2012 by Carter Pearl and Dan Flack after nine years working together at a prior firm. The firm runs concentrated, bottom-up U.S. equity portfolios under an explicit 'advisor for life' philosophy, deliberately staying focused on investment management and financial planning rather than expanding into adjacent services. No third-party awards, 'best places to work' recognition, or press coverage beyond the firm's own site and standard RIA directory listings were found despite targeted searches.
firm_note.source: Firm website (ivpaz.com/about/us, ivpaz.com/team); web search for third-party recognition and press came up empty

Carter Allen Pearl.bio_note: Carter Pearl has spent more than 30 years in investment management and holds the CFA designation. Before co-founding Intrinsic Value Partners in 2012, he ran his own firm, Pearl Capital Management, managing over $40 million in equity and fixed income accounts and consulting for one of Phoenix's prominent entrepreneurs and merchant bankers. Earlier in his career he worked at Phoenix investment bank Peacock, Hislop, Staley & Given authoring equity research and supporting investment banking work, and before that served as a Trust Portfolio Manager at First Interstate Trust Investments, where he oversaw 300+ accounts totaling more than $120 million and helped generate investment ideas for a roughly $1 billion equity portfolio. He currently sits on the investment committees of the Diocese of Phoenix and the Xavier Foundation, and previously served on the investment committee of The Catholic Community Foundation.
Carter Allen Pearl.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirmed current title (Co-Founder) and tenure only, no narrative; firm website (ivpaz.com/team, ivpaz.com/about/us): detailed career history across Pearl Capital Management, Peacock Hislop Staley & Given, and First Interstate Trust Investments, plus nonprofit/institutional board service; web search independently corroborated the same employment history and confirmed no additional press, awards, or speaking engagements exist beyond the firm's own materials

Daniel Steven Flack.bio_note: Dan Flack has 15+ years in investment management and holds the CFA designation, which he earned while working in operations, portfolio management, and investment research at a prior registered investment advisory firm before co-founding Intrinsic Value Partners with Carter Pearl in 2012 (the two had worked together for nine years prior). His path into finance was a career change — he started as an industrial engineer at a Fortune 500 service company after earning a Bachelor's degree in Systems and Industrial Engineering from the University of Arizona (1995-1998). Outside the firm, he has served on the boards of Phoenix Christian Academy, Matthew's Crossing Food Bank, and a Chandler-area church.
Daniel Steven Flack.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirmed current title (Partner) and tenure only, no narrative; firm website (ivpaz.com/team, ivpaz.com/about/us): detailed engineering-to-finance career background, University of Arizona degree, and nonprofit board service; web search independently corroborated the same details and confirmed no press, awards, or speaking engagements exist beyond the firm's own materials

firm_note.text: Fee-only, fiduciary financial advisory firm headquartered in Gilbert, Arizona, serving investors nationwide (~$1.03B AUM). Positions itself around a conflict-free, institutional-style advisory model with specialization in high-net-worth clients holding concentrated stock positions, professional athletes, and business owners. Runs a proprietary covered-call strategy (IPOM - Income Producing Options Model) it has operated for over 11 years, and co-developed 'Your Life Incorporated,' a financial-planning framework built specifically for professional athletes' personal finances. Family-continuity dimension: co-founder Brad Gwilliam's son Kimball joined the firm in 2022, extending it into a second generation.
firm_note.source: Firm website (wattsgwilliam.com/about-us, /what-we-do, team pages): confirms fee-only/fiduciary positioning, IPOM strategy tenure, and 'Your Life Incorporated' athlete framework. Web search: confirms Kimball Gwilliam's 2022 join and family lineage; searched explicitly for third-party recognition (Best Places to Work, Inc. 5000, Phoenix Business Journal rankings, other press) and found none.

Jeffrey Stephen Watts.bio_note: Co-founder of Watts Gwilliam & Company and member of its investment committee. Built his practice around clients who acquired wealth through closely held businesses, equity compensation, and professional athletics, with deep specialization in employee stock options and concentrated stock positions — he has taught seminars at some of the largest U.S. public companies on stock option tax consequences and diversification techniques. B.A. in Finance from the Marriott School of Management at Brigham Young University. Married to Kari, with five children; based in Gilbert. Outside the firm he's an endurance athlete — ultratrail running and rim-to-rim-rim Grand Canyon hikes.
Jeffrey Stephen Watts.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirms as Founding Member (accuracy 98), 21 years industry experience, Series 66; no narrative career detail in profile itself. Firm website (team bio page): full narrative on specialization, seminar work, BYU education, and family. Web search: corroborated via U.S. News advisor profile and SmartAdvisorMatch; searched specifically for press mentions and industry recognition — none found beyond firm's self-reported seminar activity.

Daniel Bradford Gwilliam.bio_note: Co-founder ('Brad' Gwilliam), oversees implementation of option and investment strategies for client accounts. Finance degree from the W.P. Carey School of Business at Arizona State University. Spent 5 years at Merrill Lynch as a Wealth Management Advisor before co-founding the firm, with earlier experience covering the Midwest region and on the trading desk for a national mutual fund company. A third-generation Arizona native; his son Kimball joined the firm in 2022, carrying the practice into a second generation. Married to Jo, with six children; active in ASU football fandom, coaching kids' sports, and community volunteering.
Daniel Bradford Gwilliam.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirms as Co-Founder (accuracy 99, matched under nickname 'Brad Gwilliam'); no narrative in profile itself. Web search: corroborated Merrill Lynch/ASU background and found the Kimball Gwilliam second-generation detail confirming his son joined in 2022. No press or award mentions found beyond firm's own materials.

David Bruce Watts.bio_note: Co-founder; focuses on financial planning and strategy for business owners, professional athletes, and other high-net-worth clients, with specialties in single-stock diversification, wealth transfer planning, tax minimization for employee stock options, and risk management. Co-developed 'Your Life Incorporated,' a financial-planning framework built specifically for professional athletes. B.S. from BYU's Marriott School of Management, where he played varsity football, followed by a Professional Financial Planner designation from UC Santa Barbara. Before co-founding the firm, spent six years at Merrill Lynch & Co. (five in Los Angeles, one in Phoenix). Married to Lori, with five children, based in Gilbert; enjoys surfing, travel, and photography.
David Bruce Watts.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirms as Founding Member (accuracy 98), 27 years industry experience, Series 66, with firm since 2004; no narrative in profile itself. Firm website (team bio page): full career/education history and the 'Your Life Incorporated' athlete-planning framework credit. Web search: corroborated BYU varsity football and Merrill Lynch tenure via independent advisor-directory snippets. No press or award mentions found beyond firm's own materials.

firm_note.text: WLTH Capital Management is an independent, SEC-registered, fee-only RIA in Chandler, AZ that officially launched May 7, 2025, founded by Cean Kenefick-Rogers (former Co-Founder/CEO of Ironwood Wealth Management). Firm targets high-net-worth individuals, business owners, and philanthropists with $5M+ investable assets, offering financial planning, portfolio management, tax planning, and charitable giving strategies (motto: "Integrity. Trust. Prosperity."). Announced via two PRWeb press releases: firm launch (May 2025) and, in September 2025, expansion into advanced philanthropic planning after the firm secured the CPWA credential. AUM ~$229.8M across 83 clients per web search.
firm_note.source: Web search + WebFetch of firm website (wlthcapitalmanagement.com) and two PRWeb press releases (firm launch and philanthropic-expansion announcements). No ZoomInfo company record checked separately (see person-level ZoomInfo note).

Cean Nicholas Kenefick-rogers.bio_note: Cean Kenefick-Rogers has 20+ years in financial services. He co-founded Ironwood Wealth Management (Chandler, AZ) roughly two decades ago, starting his career in the insurance and brokerage worlds before he and his partners transitioned the firm to an independent RIA, ultimately dropping their FINRA licenses on legal advice. He served as Ironwood's CEO for the firm's last six years, during which he led it to just under $550M AUM across nearly 500 households. In an early growth phase, he and his partners hit a compensation/accountability standoff across their differing books of business and brought in an outside industry consultant to restructure partner roles and pay — a turnaround he later discussed publicly as a notable case study in RIA partnership management, featured as a full episode (Ep. 306, Nov 2022) of Michael Kitces' industry-leading 'Financial Advisor Success' podcast. In May 2025 he left Ironwood to found WLTH Capital Management, LLC in Chandler, AZ, where he is Founder, CEO, and Managing Partner, focused on high-net-worth households and philanthropists with $5M+ in investable assets. The firm's launch and subsequent expansion (adding the CPWA credential in September 2025) were both covered in PRWeb press releases. He holds the CFA, CFP, CPWA, and AIF designations. His stated philosophy emphasizes trust-based client relationships and aligning wealth strategy with clients' personal values and philanthropic goals.
Cean Nicholas Kenefick-rogers.bio_source: ZoomInfo: no record found via search_contacts under any name-component variant — consistent with prior round's finding. Firm website: wlthcapitalmanagement.com confirms credentials, 20+ years experience, Founder & CEO role, firm philosophy/motto. Web search (primary lever): confirmed firm launch PRWeb release (May 2025) with career summary and 'former Co-Founder and CEO of Ironwood Wealth Management' detail; second PRWeb release (Sept 2025) with CPWA credential and philanthropic-planning quote; Kitces.com blog post and Ironwood Wealth Management site confirmed the Kitces 'Financial Advisor Success' Ep. 306 (Nov 2022) podcast feature on partnership/compensation restructuring, career origin, ~$550M AUM/500 households at Ironwood, and 6 years as Ironwood CEO (corroborated via search-result summaries citing kitces.com, ironwoodwm.com, and the podcast listing after a direct fetch was blocked). AdvisorCheck.com profile page was rate-limited and not relied upon.

firm_note.text: Founded by Jonathan Bird in 2019, Farnam Financial is a fee-only fiduciary RIA in Phoenix managing ~$161M for ~87 clients (avg. account ~$1.86M), focused on clients with $2M+ investable assets who are retired or within five years of retirement. Bird deliberately built the firm as a smaller, high-touch alternative to the high-volume corporate model he came from at Schwab — capping growth via paid lead generation (Smart Asset) rather than aggressive practice acquisition, and structuring service around quarterly check-ins with fast advisor access and a 24-hour response guarantee. The firm's investment philosophy centers on low-cost index investing, tax-efficient withdrawal planning, and 'peace of mind,' which Bird describes as turning a client's 'financial house into their financial castle.'
firm_note.source: Firm website (farnamfinancial.com/about) — AUM, client count, positioning, team, service model; web search of SEC/aggregator data confirming $161.4M regulatory AUM across 87 clients; web search of retirementtaxservices.com podcast interview with Bird — founding philosophy, growth strategy. No third-party firm awards or recognition found in web search.

Jonathan David Bird.bio_note: Jonathan Bird's path into finance started unconventionally: at 23, while working as a personal caddy for billionaire investor Julian Robertson at the Kauri Cliffs golf resort in New Zealand (2011), Robertson recommended he read Warren Buffett's shareholder letters — an experience Bird cites as the spark for pursuing long-term, compounding-focused wealth management as a career. He spent six years at Charles Schwab, including three years managing 205 high-net-worth households and roughly $250M in assets within Schwab Private Client Investment Advisory, before leaving in 2019 to found Farnam Financial. He deliberately built Farnam smaller and more concentrated than his old Schwab book, prioritizing depth of relationship over volume. Bird holds the CFP and CWS designations and Series 63/66 licenses. He authored 'Income on Demand: Master Your Retirement Portfolio, Ignore the Market, and Leave the IRS Weeping,' which reached #1 bestseller status on Amazon, and has been featured in local profile press (Shoutout Arizona) and industry podcasts (Retirement Tax Services) discussing his career path and practice-building philosophy. He names Charlie Munger's 'Poor Charlie's Almanack' (read 5+ times) as a formative influence, and runs a Benjamin Franklin-style 'Junto' discussion group outside of work.
Jonathan David Bird.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirms title (Founder & Wealth Advisor, accuracy score 99), current and prior employer (Schwab Private Client Investment Advisory, ~3 yrs) — no enriched career narrative from the tool itself. Firm website (farnamfinancial.com/about): confirms CFP/CWS credentials, prior AUM/household figures, Amazon #1 bestseller book. Web search (primary lever): Shoutout Arizona local profile piece provided the Julian Robertson caddy story, Buffett/Munger influences, and founding philosophy; Retirement Tax Services podcast provided Schwab career detail and growth-strategy approach; additional corroboration via NAPFA member profile, LinkedIn, and SEC IAPD adviser summary.

firm_note.text: Independent, fee-only RIA founded in 2003 by David J. Fernandez in Scottsdale, AZ (additional office in Glendale), combining ongoing investment management with comprehensive financial planning. Positions itself around full independence, fee-only/fiduciary objectivity, a deep-dive planning process, and direct client access to the principal rather than junior staff. Targets high-net-worth individuals within 5-10 years of retirement, recently retired, or navigating a life transition. Tagline: "Simplify the complex and bring order to your financial life." No third-party firm awards or 'best places to work'-style recognition surfaced despite a targeted search; the firm's public profile is built primarily around the founder's media visibility rather than firm-level accolades.
firm_note.source: Firm website (wealth-engineering.com home, /about, /founder pages); web search specifically for firm-level awards/recognition returned no results naming Wealth Engineering.

David John Fernandez.bio_note: David J. Fernandez, CFP, founded Wealth Engineering, LLC in 2003 after a prior career at The Vanguard Group, where he worked as an Investment Manager and Financial Planner managing portfolios and providing planning for high-net-worth individuals and families. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Finance from Arizona State University and a Financial Planning Certificate from the College of Financial Planning in Denver, earning his CFP designation. Over more than twenty years in fee-only planning and investment advisory, he has built a public media profile: quoted on financial markets, trends, and forecasts by national outlets including The Wall Street Journal, Money Magazine, MSN Money, Business Week, and Dow Jones MarketWatch, as well as regional outlets The Arizona Republic and Research Magazine, and has contributed guidance to Kiplinger's Hotline and Investopedia.com. He is a member of NAPFA, a former director of the Phoenix Chapter of the Financial Planning Association, a former member of the Central Arizona Estate Planning Council, and organizer/director of the Phoenix Chapter's Financial Planning Week.
David John Fernandez.bio_source: ZoomInfo: confirms title Founder & Principal, accuracy score 98 (no additional narrative). Firm website: /founder and /about pages provided full career history (Vanguard prior role, ASU degree, CFP credential, founding year 2003), plus a detailed media-quotes and professional-association list. Web search: corroborated the media-mention claim via independent search results and the firm's own site content; did not turn up independent third-party profiles or press coverage of Fernandez personally beyond what the firm's own website states, nor any individual awards — the media-mentions claim is sourced to the firm's self-description, not independently verified article-by-article.

firm_note.text: Sage Financial Advisors Inc. is a small, long-tenured RIA team of about 7 advisors based in Scottsdale, AZ, managing roughly $270M for ~330-350 client accounts. The team includes CFPs Kelly Christensen and Sharon Bargetto alongside advisors Matthew Everroad, Jon Hermanson, and David Rauch, each with 16-20+ years of industry experience. The firm has no independent website (confirmed via its Form ADV filing) and no distinct firm-level press or awards were found; note that an unrelated, larger Pennsylvania-based firm called 'Sage Financial Group' (Cohn brothers, ~$4.2B AUM, Barron's Top 1200 recognition) shares a similar name but is a different entity and was excluded from this research.
firm_note.source: Web search: Form ADV / FinTrx firm profile confirming CRD 116933, $270M AUM, 7 employees, no website on file; advisor-directory profiles for team roster and AUM figures; web search explicitly disambiguating from the unrelated Pennsylvania 'Sage Financial Group.'

Kelly Alan Christensen.bio_note: Kelly Christensen is President and Chief Compliance Officer of Sage Financial Advisors, a CFP who has spent his entire ~26-year career at the firm since joining in 1999. He studied at the University of Oregon (1980-1984) before building a long career in comprehensive financial planning, retirement, estate, investment, insurance, and tax planning, with a specialization in employee and employer benefit plans. He holds a Series 65 license and is registered to practice in Arizona and Texas. No firm-founding claim was substantiated, no press coverage or awards specific to him were found, and no professional association leadership (NAPFA, FPA) was found.

She holds a Bachelor of Science from the University of Arizona. No press coverage, awards, or additional public background beyond this career history were found.

firm_note.text: Wise Wealth Partners is an independent, SEC-registered fee-only RIA offering "customized financial planning with institutional resources," with offices in Phoenix, AZ and Folsom, CA and nationwide client service. Founded by Brian Rellihan out of frustration with the one-size-fits-all approach at larger institutions; all advisors hold CFP credentials, and the firm emphasizes fiduciary commitment, tax-code expertise, and institutional custodial partnerships with Fidelity, TIAA, and Lincoln Financial. The firm's own site states it has been recognized by BestRate.com for financial planning excellence in both 2025 and 2026 (based on its 5-star Google review record) and cites contributions/mentions in Yahoo Finance, GoBankingRates, and U.S. News & World Report; these are firm-reported and not independently confirmed on the third-party sites. No independent local business-journal ranking or national award-list placement was found in web search.
firm_note.source: Firm website (thewwp.com, formerly wisewealthpartners.com): About/home page copy on founding story, credentials, custodians, and self-reported awards/press; web search for independent corroboration of awards and press returned no independent confirmation — noted as firm-reported only.

Brian Joseph Rellihan.bio_note: Brian Rellihan is both a practicing wealth manager and a finance educator, giving the firm a genuine teaching/thought-leadership angle beyond typical RIA marketing. He is an adjunct professor of finance at the Colangelo College of Business at Grand Canyon University (since ~2023), where he teaches upper-level finance courses; GCU's own faculty profile describes him as bringing over two decades of real-world experience in tax, finance, and real estate to the classroom, having prepared thousands of tax returns and managed portfolios exceeding $100M in AUM, and being an active residential real estate investor since the early 2000s. He holds a CFP, is an IRS-credentialed Enrolled Agent, and has an MBA (St. Ambrose University) plus a BA from the University of Northern Iowa and graduate accounting coursework at ASU's W.P. Carey School of Business. Career history: registered representative at TIAA-CREF Individual & Institutional Services before becoming Managing Member & Chief Compliance Officer of Wise Wealth Partners (Jul 2013-Nov 2020), then Founder/Senior Financial Advisor there from Dec 2020 — explaining the firm's TIAA custodial relationship. He also separately founded and serves as Chief Learning Officer of 721ce, LLC, a continuing-education venture focused on IRC Section 721 (UPREIT) exchanges and real estate investment strategies. On the firm's own site he is quoted: "I'm continually surprised — not in a good way — by how many financial professionals don't prepare their own tax returns."
